_doc: CF-THE-CANARY-IS-A-HAND-VERIFIED-POOL (GREAT REMATCH, Drew 2026-09-01). The holdings whose pools Drew verified by hand. rematch-canary-check.cjs recomputes each pool's FMV inputs before and after a shard's apply-improve and FAILS the shard on any regression. Fetched read-only from the portfolio container 2026-09-01; poolRows are the measured row counts at that instant (cardId partition + hobbyiqCardId field, unioned) and are a FLOOR, never an equality assertion -- ingest adds sales legitimately.
_verifiedMarketDirection: What Drew's verification established about the pool. `exact-pool` = the slug's own sales are the market and must stay reachable. `graded-from-raw` = the pool prices its graded tier off its own raw children through the empirical curve (D-graded-to-raw), so the RAW pool must stay reachable too. A canary regresses when its pool loses rows, when its anchor moves away from the verified market, or when any write touches a protected row.

canaries.name: Verlander 2005 Bowman Chrome DP BDP129 PSA 10
canaries.note: Drew pinned the slug: hobbyiqCardIdSource=manual-chrome-2026-08-10, 'Confirmed chrome by Drew; do not re-derive to paper'. A re-derivation that moves this pool toward bowman (paper) is a REGRESSION, never an improvement -- the pin is the ruling. The X-Fractor-in-base-pool shape belongs to THIS card number.

canaries.name: Figueroa 2026 Bowman Chrome CPA-VF Black & White Red Ink auto
canaries.note: Red Ink is the SSP of the B&W Shimmer auto and its OWN row (Drew 2026-08-30) -- never folded into a shade of red. The holding's stored cardId is still a vendor bubble id (1778815951741x...), so the pool lives under the hobbyiqCardId slug: the canary must read the UNION or it measures nothing. Single-sale pool: losing that row empties the pool.

canaries.name: Shaq 1993 Topps Finest #99 Refractor
canaries.note: The union is 55 = 2 rows in the slug's own partition + 53 carrying it as hobbyiqCardId -- the split the union measures. Topps Finest #197 lists `Uncommon` AND `Uncommon Refractor` as two cards, which is why the retracted trailing-' Refractor' strip must never come back: it would fold this pool into its sibling.

canaries.name: Gonzalez 2026 Bowman CPA-JG Refractor auto /499
canaries.note: Base-auto-on-refractor-slug shape. The stored key already carries parallel=refractor, isAuto and num-499; a re-derivation from a terse title that drops the print run or the auto flag is a REGRESSION (less specific), not an improvement. Direct match: 55 sales of this exact card.

canaries.name: Witt 2020 Bowman Draft BD-152 Image Variation PSA 9
canaries.note: An Image Variation is a NAMED card (#1613), not a finish -- a re-derivation that flattens image-variation to base is a regression. The D33 bcp-misfiled lane already worked this card number; the pool is thin (1 row) so any loss empties it.

canaries.name: Caglianone 2024 Bowman Draft CPA-JC Refractor auto /499 PSA 9
canaries.note: Bowman Draft is its own family, not Bowman. The union is 38-40 = 25 rows in the slug partition + 15 carrying it as hobbyiqCardId (poolRows is the captured floor; the pool gains rows as ingest runs). The graded tier prices off this pool's own raw children, so the raw rows are load-bearing even for the PSA 9 holding.

canaries.name: Judge 2017 Topps Gold Label #86 Class 1 Blue PSA 9
canaries.note: Gold Label is its own family, not Topps flagship. Estimated from this card's own Raw sales x the empirical PSA 9 ratio (1.65x) -- there is no PSA 9 sale of this card in 180d, so the RAW rows in this pool ARE the valuation. All 5 rows sit in the cardId partition and none carry hobbyiqCardId; a re-key that moves them without the field following makes the pool unreadable.

_derivedCanaries: CF-A-CANARY-PER-SHARD (2026-09-03). The gate is per-shard, so a shard with no canary passes by construction -- 25 of 32 did, slot 29 among them. Entries with derivedFrom='provenance' are DERIVED, not hand-verified: each is a pool anchored by rows a person's own transaction, a Drew ruling or a verification placed there, which the rematch may never re-key. They are a floor on damage, never a substitute for Drew's seven.
